description: Docs gap: the indicator-feed snapshot PUT is a multipart upload with a `source` file part (plain STIX2/CRDF or gzipped), but the docs list no body parameters — without it the upload has no payload. Transcribed from v0.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The file to upload. Either a plain STIX2/CRDF body or a gzipped one (recognised by 0x1f 0x8b magic bytes or a .gz filename suffix).
